title: Gone (2017 TV series)
premise_summary: Gone is an internationally co-produced police procedural crime drama television series created by Matt Lopez and produced by NBCUniversal International Studios. Based on Chelsea Cain's 2014 novel One Kick, the series revolves around Kit "Kick" Lannigan, a child abduction survivor, who is recruited by FBI agent Frank Novak for a special task force dedicated to solving missing persons cases. The supporting cast features Danny Pino as John Bishop, Andy Mientus as James Finley and Tracie Thoms as FBI agent Maya Kennedy.
